- Diaries & Rescues

NPC diaries record the doings of various NPCs.
Reading them can become a condition for triggering events, and some diaries appear only after an event.
Once read, a diary can also be reread as information at your base.

Rescuing witches and citizens who are held captive or being violated earns you "Karma."
With enough Karma, you can see sub-endings and more.
There is no downside.
- Attack

Press the Attack button to attack with your weapon.
(Left-click with keyboard controls.)
Hit count, attack speed and motions differ by weapon; hold the button for a slight charged attack.
The opening after an attack can be erased with a cancel action.
Consumes SP.
- Stat Requirements

Weapons and spells have stat requirements for equipping. If your stats fall below them, you can still equip the item, but with penalties such as halved effectiveness and doubled SP cost.\n\nStats gained from leveling up can be reset any number of times at the Parish Church in your base, so you can reallocate them freely.
- Attack Canceling

Motions have windows in which they can be canceled. When the glow around the weapon icon frame at the bottom left fades, you can chain into a different action such as your next attack, a step or a spell.\n\nAn important technique for erasing the opening after attacking, e.g. several attacks followed by a step.
- Downed State

Strong attacks and certain other enemy attacks will tear your clothes off and knock you down.
If an enemy touches you in this state, an H-scene begins. (Some contain ryona or gore, but you will be warned.)

You can escape with the Attack or Confirm button, etc.
Pressing the Jump button also lets you zoom in through several levels.
- Guard

Press the Guard button to guard against attacks.
(Right-click with keyboard controls.)
Damage taken varies by weapon, but guarding right before an enemy attack lands blocks all damage with any weapon.
A Just Guard (right before the hit) also instantly restores all SP, and with some weapons restores MP as well.
- Recovery

Heal with the recovery item button (on keyboard, use with Q; R switches between MP and HP recovery).

Touching an altar restores you to full.
Obtaining certain items also raises the maximum number of uses.
- Jump
Press the Jump button (Space on keyboard) to jump.\n\nPress it again mid-jump to jump once more in the air; jumping during a step performs a long jump.

While guarding, press Up (W by default on keyboard) to perform a "Parry" that deflects an enemy attack.
If the enemy staggers after the parry, approach and press the Confirm button
to perform a "Revenge Strike."
(Special effects such as healing are planned for later.)
- Altars

You can do many things here.
Always save your progress here; the game does not save automatically.
If you are defeated, you return to the last altar you touched, so be sure to touch every one you find.

Touching one fully restores everything, including recovery flasks, but enemies also revive.
- Dodge Step

Press the Step key (F on keyboard) or double-tap a direction key to perform a dodge step.
It can also be used to cancel attacks and spells.
It is also important for movement, e.g. step jumps and air steps.
Consumes SP.
- Dropping Through Floors

On floors you can pass through, tree branches and the like, press ↓+Jump to drop through.

These are mostly floors thinner or narrower than their surroundings.
Of course, you can also pass through them from below to climb up.
- Grab and Climb
Hold ↑ on the direction keys while touching a climbable ledge to perform a "climbing jump."\n\nKeep holding it to keep climbing as long as there is something to grab.
